ItemID: unavailable; Title: SanDisk Ultra 32GB microSDHC UHS-I Card with Adapter, Silver, Standard Packaging (SDSQUNC-032G-GN6MA); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I regularly use memory cards, and another 32GB card with an adapter would be useful for my devices.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my Samsung TV, although its 720p screen would not benefit from 4K.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for practical accessories right now and have no particular need for a voice assistant.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Logitech Wireless Touch Keyboard K400 with Built-In Multi-Touch Touchpad; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The combined keyboard and touchpad looks useful, but I do not currently have a setup that needs it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming fits my TV use, but I would choose the other Fire TV Stick on this page instead of buying both.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Fire Tablet with Alexa, 7" Display, 16 GB, Blue - with Special Offers (Previous Generation - 5th); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire 7 tablet and its case, so this older tablet offers little reason to replace it.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Dot (3rd Gen, 2018 release) - Smart speaker with Alexa - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A smart speaker does not address the storage, charging, or camera accessory needs I am browsing for.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Panasonic ErgoFit Wired Earbuds, In-Ear Headphones with Microphone and Call Controller, Ergonomic Custom-Fit Earpieces (S/M/L), 3.5mm Jack for Phones and Laptops - RP-TCM125-A (Blue); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These could be handy, but I do not currently need replacement earbuds.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for a dedicated smart display alongside my tablet and TV.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Anker Soundcore Bluetooth Speaker with 24-Hour Playtime, 66-Feet Bluetooth Range & Built-in Mic, Dual-Driver Portable Wireless Speaker with Low Harmonic Distortion and Superior Sound - Blue; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Portable audio is not a current priority; I would spend this visit on storage or TV connectivity.
